objects.name: Detection technique coverage: kubernetes-abuse-of-secret-by-unusual-location
objects.description: The following analytic detects unauthorized access or misuse of Kubernetes Secrets from unusual locations. It leverages Kubernetes Audit logs to identify anomalies in access patterns by analyzing the source of requests by country. This activity is significant for a SOC as Kubernetes Secrets store sensitive information like passwords, OAuth tokens, and SSH keys, making them critical assets.
